column1: # Kraken2 (confidence 0.2, min-hit-groups 2) + Bracken against the extended database (base libraries + 594 fungal genomes incl. 50 Neocallimastigomycota and the three diet mushrooms); 32 samples; reads = non-host read pairs. Fungi clade reads: median 2286.1 ppm (range 768.3-10611.8), of which a median 84% sit unresolved at the Fungi node and 41.5 ppm (median) reach a genus; Neocallimastigomycetes (anaerobic gut fungi): 30/32 samples with >=1 read, median 3.40 ppm, max 22.11; fed mushroom species: 31/32 samples, median 20.73 ppm.

# Database scope: the library set is archaea, bacteria, viral, human, protozoa and fungi. There is NO plant library, so Viridiplantae_reads is structurally 0 in every sample and is not evidence that no plant DNA is present; the only metazoan genome is human, so Metazoa_reads means human reads. scripts/fungal_profiling_tables.py
